Which statement about an alloy is correct?
A
It is a compound made of two or more elements, one of which is a metal.
B
It is a layer of a metal plated onto another metal.
C
It is a mixture of a metal with one or more other elements.
D
It is a single element.

options.label: A
options.text: It is a compound made of two or more elements, one of which is a metal.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a layer of a metal plated onto another metal.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a mixture of a metal with one or more other elements.
